package config

import (
	"errors"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type Config struct {
	HTTPHost             string
	HTTPPort             int
	Environment          string
	DatabaseURL          string
	InternalAPIToken     string
	AIPromptURL          string
	AIPromptToken        string
	LearningPlannerURL   string
	LearningPlannerToken string
	SandboxURL           string
	SandboxToken         string
	ValidationURL        string
	ValidationToken      string
	PracticeURL          string
	PracticeStagingToken string
}

func Load() (Config, error) {
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(value("HTTP_PORT", "8094"))
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	cfg := Config{HTTPHost: value("HTTP_HOST", ""), HTTPPort: port, Environment: value("APP_ENV", "development"), DatabaseURL: value("DATABASE_URL", "postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/tz_planner?sslmode=disable"), InternalAPIToken: value("INTERNAL_API_TOKEN", "change-me-tz-planner-api"), AIPromptURL: value("AI_PROMPT_SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:8091"), AIPromptToken: value("AI_PROMPT_INTERNAL_TOKEN", "change-me"), LearningPlannerURL: value("LEARNING_PLANNER_URL", "http://localhost:8080"), LearningPlannerToken: value("LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN", "change-me-internal"), SandboxURL: value("SANDBOX_SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:8085"), SandboxToken: value("SANDBOX_INTERNAL_TOKEN", "change-me"), ValidationURL: value("VALIDATION_ORCHESTRATOR_URL", "http://localhost:8090"), ValidationToken: value("VALIDATION_ORCHESTRATOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN", "change-me"), PracticeURL: value("PRACTICE_TASK_SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:8092"), PracticeStagingToken: value("LW_PRACTICE_TZ_TOKEN", "change-me-tz-planner")}
	return cfg, cfg.Validate()
}
func (cfg Config) Validate() error {
	if cfg.HTTPPort < 1 || cfg.HTTPPort > 65535 || blank(cfg.DatabaseURL) || blank(cfg.InternalAPIToken) || blank(cfg.AIPromptURL) || blank(cfg.AIPromptToken) || blank(cfg.LearningPlannerURL) || blank(cfg.LearningPlannerToken) || blank(cfg.SandboxURL) || blank(cfg.SandboxToken) || blank(cfg.ValidationURL) || blank(cfg.ValidationToken) || blank(cfg.PracticeURL) || blank(cfg.PracticeStagingToken) {
		return errors.New("tz planner configuration is incomplete")
	}
	if cfg.InternalAPIToken == cfg.PracticeStagingToken {
		return errors.New("INTERNAL_API_TOKEN and LW_PRACTICE_TZ_TOKEN must be distinct")
	}
	if strings.ToLower(cfg.Environment) != "development" && strings.ToLower(cfg.Environment) != "test" {
		for _, token := range []string{cfg.InternalAPIToken, cfg.AIPromptToken, cfg.LearningPlannerToken, cfg.SandboxToken, cfg.ValidationToken, cfg.PracticeStagingToken} {
			if strings.HasPrefix(token, "change-me") {
				return errors.New("default internal tokens are forbidden outside development")
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func value(key, fallback string) string {
	if result, ok := os.LookupEnv(key); ok {
		return strings.TrimSpace(result)
	}
	return fallback
}
func blank(value string) bool { return strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" }
